How is the `.][times][cmd][~grep][@[@iter]addr!size][|>pipe` radare2 command family constructed?

The full `?*` grammar describes `.][times][cmd][~grep][@[@iter]addr!size][|>pipe` command family and the variants accepted by the command parser. Read the leftmost letters as the command family and the following letters, suffixes, or arguments as refinements. When building one-liners, combine the family with repeat prefixes, `@` temporary seeks, `~` grep, `j` JSON output, `*` script output, or iterators when the family supports them.
